title: Presidential removal power
question: Can Congress protect officers from removal at will?

steps.note: The President may remove executive officers; Senate consent to removal is invalid.
Congress may protect “quasi-legislative, quasi-judicial” commissioners for cause.
Adjudicatory bodies get for-cause protection even when the statute is silent.
Congress cannot keep removal power over an officer who executes the law.
Good-cause protection is valid unless it impedes the President’s constitutional functions.
Humphrey’s Executor overruled: FTC commissioners are removable at will.
